name: Cubing in School Westminster 2025

information: Welcome back to the renowned Westminster Schools for a WCA competition supported by **[Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)**! Please check out the Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab to learn more about the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM0MTIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b98b0afad56e63df3ed9ae2dab95f4ce818ee94e/SOUTHEAST_5.png) This competition is located on a school campus without specific addresses for individual buildings, so please review the Venue and Travel tab before registering to ensure you understand how to navigate to the building where the competition will be held.
